## unit F7 objective 7.1

### Q1 TEST_IMPORT_MD: which board is accountable for architecture governance?
- [ ] The programme board
- [x] The Architecture Board
- [ ] The CIO council
- [ ] The change advisory board
> The Architecture Board governs the architecture and the contracts.
refs: GOV §3

### Q2 TEST_IMPORT_MD: what does an Architecture Contract bind?
- [x] The sponsors and the implementation partners to the architecture
- [ ] The vendors to a price
- [ ] The repository to a metamodel
- [ ] The CIO to a budget
> The contract is the agreement between development partners and sponsors on the deliverables and their compliance.
refs: GOV §4
